note: Small committed summary only. Full run directory, SQLite files, caches and raw logs remain local and git-ignored.

execution_context.code_commit_under_test: 40c0a3660ac96f40048b597a58e851a22f8feec7 (baseline) plus the transport-repair working tree described in README
execution_context.rerun_policy: No reruns, no best-of selection, no manual action rewriting. The agent arm ran exactly once.

frozen_settings.roles: The model only selects the next action; RDKit performs every deterministic molecular edit and property calculation.

agent.model_request_evidence_gap: The agent arm built its LLMPolicy outside the Harness, so the Harness evidence sink was not installed and no model_request event was persisted. This is a code defect found by this run and fixed afterwards; the run itself was NOT repeated.

failure_analysis.transport_verdict: Transport is fixed. 4/4 planner responses succeeded and there were 0 network retries and 0 final network failures, versus 6 retries and 3 final network failures in v3.
failure_analysis.root_cause: The model added an evidence_ids key inside each option object. The schema correctly rejected it, but the error message listed only the allowed keys and never named the offending key, so the planner repeated the same malformed call three times.

behaviour_chain_observed.changed_candidate_or_strategy_after_nega: no; it repeated the identical call

fixes_landed_after_this_run: schema errors now name the exact missing/unexpected keys
an injected LLMPolicy now receives the Harness evidence sink so model_request records are persisted
the planner prompt now lists the exact allowed option keys and states that evidence_ids belongs to select_edit only
failure_analysis.fix_validation: Offline only (267 passed, 1 skipped). No second real agent run was performed.

interpretation_limits: The agent did not reach the score threshold. That alone does not show the agent is ineffective.
The agent stopped on schema rejections, so this run cannot evaluate molecular decision quality beyond evaluating the parent.
Zero actual edits, zero parent-child comparisons, zero strategy changes.
A proposed option is never counted as an actual edit.
A schema rejection is never counted as a network failure and vice versa.
One parent and one model run cannot demonstrate superiority over the rule arm.
This does not show the model learned medicinal chemistry.
Total-score changes must not be extrapolated to individual property improvements.
Reachability audit scores were computed separately and never passed to either policy.
next_steps: If a future v4 completes the full action chain, run a small stability study: 2-3 parents, at most 3 repeats each.
If v4 fails on transport again, replace or isolate the transport layer before spending more real experiment quota.
Do not extend to full 3D, docking, or n=20 yet.
